arguments.summary: A data exfiltration attempt was detected from workstation WS-FIN-019 (10.0.4.19) in the Finance department. The endpoint used DNS tunneling via high-entropy TXT queries to the domain ns1.exfil-c2.example.com, resolving to 203.0.113.77. Correlation with historical data revealed that the same C2 domain was previously used by WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.42) in a confirmed Cobalt Strike beaconing incident. Despite sandbox analysis returning 'clean' for associated payloads, behavioral and network indicators confirm malicious activity. No containment actions were approved during the Admin phase, leaving the threat potentially active.

timeline.description: External scan from 203.0.113.77 detected against internal host 10.0.2.15 (WS-IT-101). Logged as low severity.
Initial C2 beaconing from WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.42) to 198.51.100.23 observed. Suspicious rundll32 execution detected.
IDS alert triggered: 'ET TROJAN Cobalt Strike Beacon C2 Activity' from WS-FIN-042 to 198.51.100.23.
Lateral movement via SMB from WS-FIN-042 to file server 10.0.5.50 confirmed.
New data exfiltration alert from WS-FIN-019 (10.0.4.19) to 203.0.113.77 via DNS tunneling using ns1.exfil-c2.example.com.
SIEM correlation confirms same C2 infrastructure used in prior incident. Domain ns1.exfil-c2.example.com linked to multiple malicious activities.
EDR query shows chrome.exe on WS-FIN-019 making DNS queries with high entropy. No suspicious child processes detected.
Containment actions (firewall block, EPP quarantine, IAM disable) requested but denied due to policy or evidence mismatch.

title: DNS Tunneling via High-Entropy TXT Queries to Known Malicious Domain
id: 7a8b9c0d-1234-5678-90ab-cdef12345678
status: experimental
description: Detects DNS queries with high entropy subdomains for known malicious domains, often used in data exfiltration.
references:
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1071/004/
author: SOC Team
date: 2026-04-10
logsource:

    product: windows
    service: dns
detection:
    selection:
        QueryType: TXT
        QueryName|contains: '.exfil-c2.example.com'
        SubdomainEntropy|gte: 3.5
    condition: selection
fields:
    - QueryName
    - ClientIP
    - SubdomainEntropy
level: high
